decisions.reason: As a multi-model extension close to the firm's traditional handcrafted seasonal décor and promoted prominently on the home page, it fits core capabilities and gives management little reason to reverse course.
This product sits very near the firm's established Christmas pyramid business and was visibly promoted, so both strategic fit and modest commitment pressures favor continuation.

Although technologically more distant from the firm's craft-based core, it was presented as a flagship with several models and public prominence, which under escalation of commitment makes management likely to persist.
As a complementary product tied to the electronic music box platform and even given a second edition and its own page, it has enough attached investment and justification pressure to remain for now.

This seasonal music-box variant is more peripheral, less visibly committed than the flagship line, and easier to discontinue without undermining the firm's broader identity, so management is likelier to let it go.
A themed Christmas pyramid builds directly on the firm's long-established strengths and public promotion, making continued offering more likely than withdrawal.
